title: Vasaloppet Prep - Lower Body & Core Strength

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through each transition, focus on spinal mobility and breathing. Fully extend in cow, fully flex in cat.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the rotation from one side to the other. Keep chest upright and engaged. Smooth transitions between positions.

items.name: Band Pullaparts
items.cues: Light resistance band. Pull the band apart to chest level with straight arms. Activate shoulders and upper back. Controlled tempo.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Alternate sides. Extend opposite arm and leg fully. Core stays tight, no spinal rotation. Pause briefly at full extension.

items.name: Back Squat
items.cues: Full depth squat with control. Drive through heels on ascent. Maintain neutral spine. RPE 6-7 range - challenging but controlled reps.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.cues: Rear foot elevated on bench. Front leg does the work. Drop knee nearly to ground, drive through front heel. Dumbbells in hands for added load.

items.name: Bent Over Row
items.cues: Barbell bent-over row. Hip hinge with neutral spine. Row to lower chest. Engage lats and mid-back. Explosive up, controlled down.

items.name: Cable Core Press
items.cues: Standing with cable at chest height. Press straight out, resisting rotation. Core bracing essential. Alternate sides each rep.

items.name: Back Extension
items.cues: Hyperextension bench or bodyweight. Extend hips, lifting torso slightly above parallel. Squeeze glutes and hamstrings at top. Control descent.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Gentle, controlled spinal flexion and extension. Focus on breathing and relaxation. Let tension release from lower back.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold 45 seconds each leg against wall or bench. Keep heel on ground, lean forward. Feel stretch in calf muscle.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Back of hands against wall, arms extended. Lean forward to feel chest and biceps stretch. Hold 45 seconds each side.

items.name: Child's Pose
items.cues: Knees wide, sink hips to heels, arms extended forward. Relax shoulders and neck. Breathe deeply for 90 seconds.

rationale: 53 days to Vasaloppet 90km race - focus on building lower body and posterior chain strength critical for long-distance skiing and endurance on varied terrain

Intermediate fitness level with strong recent endurance session (55min, RPE 6) calls for moderate-high intensity strength work (RPE 6-7) targeting squats, rows, and core stability essential for cross-country skiing power and efficiency

Total workout duration ~45 minutes matches target while building strength without excessive fatigue; emphasis on compound movements (squats, rows) and functional core work mirrors demands of prolonged skiing activity
